mapper.insert: insert into content_embeddings ( content_id, model_key, source_hash, dimensions, embedding ) values ( #{id}, #{model}, #{sourceHash}, #{dimensions}, cast(#{vector,typeHandler=com.github.hgdcoder.flowershow.persistence.mapper.recommendation.FloatVectorTypeHandler} as vector) ) on conflict (content_id, model_key) do update set source_hash = excluded.source_hash, dimensions = excluded.dimensions, embedding = excluded.embedding, updated_at = current_timestamp

merge into content_embeddings ( content_id, model_key, source_hash, dimensions, embedding, updated_at ) key (content_id, model_key) values ( #{id}, #{model}, #{sourceHash}, #{dimensions}, #{vector,typeHandler=com.github.hgdcoder.flowershow.persistence.mapper.recommendation.FloatVectorTypeHandler}, current_timestamp )

mapper.select: select cast(null as varchar) as id, cast(null as double precision) as similarity where 1 = 0

select ce.content_id as id, 1 - (ce.embedding <=> ui.embedding) as similarity from user_interest_embeddings ui join content_embeddings ce on ce.model_key = ui.model_key and ce.dimensions = ui.dimensions join content_items c on c.id = ce.content_id where ui.actor_key = #{actorKey} and ui.model_key = #{model} and ui.dimensions = #{dimensions} and c.status = 'published' and c.visibility = 'public' and c.type = 'video' order by ce.embedding <=> ui.embedding, ce.content_id limit #{limit}
